data.reason_zh: 明确将元技能作为可优化工件，执行轨迹反馈驱动改写，并在多任务上精炼后复用。

scope_support.feedback_quote: The meta agent diagnoses execution traces, proposes candidates, requests independent reviews, and allocates the search budget.
scope_support.object_quote: a meta agent follows a meta-skill to optimize task skills and optimizes the meta-skill itself using the same procedure.
scope_support.persistence_quote: This meta-skill is also decoupled from task skills, refined on multiple skill optimization tasks and then reused to optimize task skills across diverse domains.
